english.title: Run aircraft engine in hangar / non-designated area at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited, or without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse, ran an aircraft engine in

(A)_[a hangar]_
(B)_[an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..),]_

at Bristol Airport, not designated for that purpose by Bristol Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.2 and 3.3 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse in circumstances in which the obtaining of permission would be likely to hinder that person so acting.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited, or without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse, ran an aircraft engine in
